quest.title: Sword, Fish, Resistance
quest.description: At Sangonomiya Kokomi's invitation, you decide to visit Sangonomiya Shrine, the headquarters of the resistance army.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x650, Mora x31125, Hero's Wit x3, Mystic Enhancement Ore x6

talks.objective: Go to the agreed location and meet Teppei

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: #Aha, {NICKNAME}, there you are, good to see you.

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: Your appointment with Sangonomiya is fast approaching. We should get going.

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: Are you ready? We'll start by heading to the camp on <color=#00E1FFFF>Watatsumi Island</color>, and then we'll go meet Her Excellency together from there.

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: If you start to feel seasick at any point during the trip, let me know straight away. That said, you've spent time with the Crux Fleet in the past, so I think you'll probably be fine...

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: Ready... and away we go!

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: Here we are. The training grounds for Watatsumi Island's troops.

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: Right now, the resistance is predominantly made up of local soldiers from Watatsumi Island.

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: Some of them are fighting with the Shogun's Army in Tatarasuna, and some of them are stationed here on the island to keep the locals safe.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Did you use to train here, too?

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: Yep! Unfortunately, I had to join the fight in Tatarasuna before I'd had the chance to impress the instructors. So they had me start off by helping out in the logistics division...

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: I'll be staying here for now. If you need me for anything, just come here.

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: If I'm not around, just write a note and stick it on the wall. As soon as I see it, I'll come find you...

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: ...Shoot, it's nearly time for the appointment with <color=#00E1FFFF>Her Excellency</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: I'll have to show you around Watatsumi Island some other time. For now, let's get ourselves over to <color=#00E1FFFF>Sangonomiya</color>!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So Sangonomiya is the name of the place where <color=#00E1FFFF>Sangonomiya Kokomi</color> lives... huh. Let's go check it out.

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: Food supplies are the absolute top priority, period. We cannot afford any losses.

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: With the conflict between us and the Shogun's Army getting more intense by the day, we must prioritize the stability of the rearguard.

dialogues.speaker: Ookubo Daisuke
dialogues.text: Understood. I will think of a way...

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: Take heart. We have a fresh batch of supplies in hand, and I'm working on expanding the army.

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: I appreciate that the lack of manpower has been hard on all of you. But things are going to get better.

dialogues.speaker: Ookubo Daisuke
dialogues.text: We're expanding the army? Oh, that's great. Whoever this mystery supporter is, they're doing us a great service...

dialogues.speaker: Ookubo Daisuke
dialogues.text: Huh? Teppei? What are you doing back on Watatsumi Island?

dialogues.speaker: Ookubo Daisuke
dialogues.text: Might I ask, who...

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: Haha, VIP guests of Her Excellency, that's who. I'm acting under orders to escort them both here.

dialogues.speaker: Ookubo Daisuke
dialogues.text: Oh really? Wait, so are you the new recruit everyone's been talking about? Strength of twenty men, splits an arrow in twain from a hundred paces, skin as hard as diamond... That's you?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Seriously, what is going on with these rumors!

dialogues.speaker: Ookubo Daisuke
dialogues.text: You've come a long way. I'm sure you must be here on pressing business, so I won't disturb you any further. Feel free to visit me if you have any time to spare.

dialogues.speaker: Ookubo Daisuke
dialogues.text: Your Excellency, I'll take my leave.

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: Your Excellency, I couldn't help but overhear Ookubo mention something about... a third party supporter? What was that about?

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: Not long ago, someone wrote to me saying that they wished to support the Watatsumi Island resistance effort. To that end, they also furnished us with a great deal of supplies.

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: Thanks to them, we can finally start recruiting troops on the scale we need to openly confront the Shogun's Army on the front line.

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: I am not without my doubts about the whole affair... but Watatsumi Island is hardly affluent, and these supplies are a much-needed lifeline for us.

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: The sender's conditions were also reasonable. They simply ask us to dedicate ourselves fully to fighting against the Shogun's Army.

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: Whatever other motives they may have, we are at least aligned on this. So let's consider them an anonymous ally.

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: Naturally, we shouldn't let our guard down. If you discover anything out of the ordinary, please report it to me at once.

response.speaker: Teppei
response.text: Your Excellency, does this mean that the food at the front line is gonna get any better? I was at the field hospital the other day, and everyone was begging for some barbecued meat.

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: Hehe... Don't worry. I've already made arrangements for that. Everyone will have their fill of meat. But to be clear, still no alcohol.

response.speaker: Teppei
response.text: That's fantastic!

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: I understand how hard it's been on everyone. The resistance army's rations have barely changed at all since the Vision Hunt Decree was first announced.

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: I will discuss this with the logistics division to see what further improvements can be made.

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: However, our supplies are still limited. I must ask you to remain patient until victory is ours.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: When will the Vision Hunt Decree finally end?

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: That's the question... and I'm afraid I don't have an answer.

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: The mere existence of the Vision Hunt Decree is baffling. The Tenryou Commission's attitude just doesn't seem to add up, and neither does the Shogun's.

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: The Tenryou Commission's zealous support for the decree seemed to come out of nowhere. And the Shogun seems completely indifferent to the fact that it has effectively caused a civil war...

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: I suspect the Vision Hunt Decree won't end until these mysteries are solved. All I can say for certain is that as long as the Vision Hunt Decree remains in force, we will never give up our fight.

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: #{NICKNAME}, to confirm... knowing the current situation facing Watatsumi Island and the resistance, are you still willing to fight with us?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Yes. I won't give up, either.

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: Good. Then here is your assignment:

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: I hereby appoint you as captain of the Watatsumi Island special operations unit: Swordfish II.

response.speaker: Teppei
response.text: Whoa, whoa, whaaaat!? Swordfish II!? Is this the same Swordfish special ops unit that I'm thinking of?

response.speaker: Teppei
response.text: It's hard enough getting into a special ops unit at the bottom rung, let alone jumping to captain in one fell swoop... this is incredible!

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: Although this appointment breaks with convention, I firmly believe that with your wisdom, courage, and strength, you can lead your team to victory.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Great! So when do we take up our post?

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: The members of <color=#00E1FFFF>Swordfish II</color> are currently on standby in a <color=#00E1FFFF>valley to the southwest</color>. Ronin have been causing trouble down there lately, and we need a special operations unit to eliminate them and stabilize the rearguard.

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: I have already written your Appointment Letter, which you'll need to show them on arrival. Once that's out of the way, please lead them in ridding the area of ronin.

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: The special ops unit comprises Watatsumi Island's elite soldiers. They can be a little rough around the edges, but I have every confidence that you will win their trust.

response.speaker: Teppei
response.text: Um, what about me, Your Excellency? Any battles you need me to get involved in?

response.speaker: Teppei
response.text: I want to make a contribution to the resistance, too!

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: Of course. I'll arrange something and brief you shortly.

response.speaker: Teppei
response.text: #Alright! One successful operation, coming right up! Hehe {NICKNAME}, you may have swiped the captaincy of Swordfish II, but watch this space, 'cause this guy's on his way up!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Okay, sure. Well, be careful out there. Don't push yourself too hard.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Well {NICKNAME}, let's move out.

choices.text: Can this mystery sponsor be trusted?

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: I am not without my doubts... but Watatsumi Island is hardly affluent, and these supplies are a much-needed lifeline for us.

talks.objective: Go to where Swordfish II is stationed
Speak to the members of Swordfish II

dialogues.speaker: Swordfish II Provisional Squad Leader
dialogues.text: Ah, you must be the new captain of Swordfish II. Her Excellency briefed us in advance.

dialogues.speaker: Swordfish II Provisional Squad Leader
dialogues.text: Your reputation precedes you, and the Appointment Letter is all in order. But I still have my doubts...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm? Do you have any other questions?

dialogues.speaker: Swordfish II Provisional Squad Leader
dialogues.text: I'll be straight with you. I want to know whether you have what it takes to lead us.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You mean... like a duel?

dialogues.speaker: Swordfish II Veteran
dialogues.text: Normally, a duel would be the quickest way to settle the question. But this time, we've got a better way.

dialogues.speaker: Swordfish II Veteran
dialogues.text: We're stationed here because of all the <color=#00E1FFFF>ronin</color> causing trouble in these parts. If you can get rid of <color=#00E1FFFF>them</color> for us, we'll take that as a measure of your strength.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sure.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alright, let's show them what you're made of!

talks.objective: Speak to the members of Swordfish II

dialogues.speaker: Swordfish II Provisional Squad Leader
dialogues.text: Okay, seems like you can hold your own... The rumors are exaggerations, of course, but still, your abilities are admirable.

dialogues.speaker: Koutoku
dialogues.text: Allow me to introduce myself. My name is Koutoku, Acting Captain of Swordfish II. This is Yoshihisa, a fellow veteran of the team.

dialogues.speaker: Koutoku
dialogues.text: I now formally cede the position of captain to you. Swordfish II awaits your orders.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are there any other ronin to deal with?

dialogues.speaker: Yoshihisa
dialogues.text: There are two hard-hit areas. This was one of them, but thanks to you, this area is now secure. Their only remaining stronghold is located at the shallows on the <color=#00E1FFFF>east side of the island</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Yoshihisa
dialogues.text: That said, the ones over there are tougher, and there's more of them.

choices.text: We should go take a look.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You got that right. Watatsumi Island is busy fighting the Shogun's Army on the front line. We can't let these guys mess up things at the rear!

choices.text: Kokomi said we need to secure the rearguard.

talks.objective: Go to the area threatened by monsters
Speak to the members of Swordfish II

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: There's so many of them...

dialogues.speaker: Koutoku
dialogues.text: That's not even all of them. They have two more camps nearby.

dialogues.speaker: Koutoku
dialogues.text: Whichever camp we attack, it's the ronin in the other two camps that'll cause us issues. They might decide to provide backup or abandon them and escape on their own.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Then let's attack them all at once.

dialogues.speaker: Koutoku
dialogues.text: But Captain, that would put you in great danger...

dialogues.speaker: Koutoku
dialogues.text: If we spread our troops too thin, we won't have enough men to guard you. It's too risky.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm fine.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yup, the Traveler eats amateurs like these for breakfast!

dialogues.speaker: Koutoku
dialogues.text: All right then. We'll deal with them all in one go and rendezvous with you on completion!

talks.objective: Speak to the members of Swordfish II

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #That should be the last of them... {NICKNAME}, you didn't get hurt, did you?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Cool... Paimon wonders how everything is going with Koutoku and Yoshihisa. Should we go over and check on them?

response.speaker: Yoshihisa
response.text: Captain!

response.speaker: Koutoku
response.text: Captain, the other two camps have been cleared. The entire rearguard of Watatsumi Island is now secure.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Great! Hee-hee, we solved the ronin problem and got everyone to look up to us, too...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But what's next? Let's go back and check with Kokomi.

response.speaker: Yoshihisa
response.text: Finally, we got it done. These ronin have been bugging me for ages, but Koutoku wouldn't let us at 'em till now.

response.speaker: Koutoku
response.text: What? No way could you have taken them down without the new captain here. I was putting the safety of the team first, got it?

response.speaker: Yoshihisa
response.text: Oh come on, you were just being a coward...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey, cut the attitude!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #These guys, honestly... {NICKNAME}, forget them, <color=#00E1FFFF>let's go</color>!

talks.objective: Return to headquarters and talk to Sangonomiya Kokomi

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: #How was it, {NICKNAME}? Did your initiation go smoothly?

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: Hehe... I'm sure you're playing it down a little. Koutoku and the others put you through your paces, I presume?

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: But with your level of ability, I'm sure it was a walk in the park.

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: Since you're back, I take it that the ronin are now gone from Watatsumi Island?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You bet. We sure showed them who's boss!

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: Good. Now we just need to make sure Ookubo keeps a close watch to prevent their resurgence.

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: Thank you. I believe in rewarding merit, so you will be compensated for your hard work. Let me see... too soon for another promotion, I think. I could increase your pay...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Hey, where did Teppei go?

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: I gave him an assignment. He's taking part in a surprise attack against the Shogun's Navy.

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: He expressed a desire to be on the front line, so I honored his wishes.

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: #Now. Speaking of assignments, {NICKNAME}, I have a special mission I'd like to give you.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: A special mission?

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: Yes. In between Watatsumi Island and Tatarasuna, <color=#00E1FFFF>there are some ruins relating to a god who fell in the Archon War</color>. There are several small islands there, often used as a transit point when transporting supplies.

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: Recently, however, supplies stored there have started to go missing for no obvious reason.

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: Stranger still, the resistance army passed by and reported they found no signs of danger... I'd like to task you with getting to the bottom of this.

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: It's not urgent, so there is no need to leave immediately. I suggest you take a few days to familiarize yourselves with the army and also with Watatsumi Island.

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: When Teppei returns, you can catch up with him, then pick a day when the weather's good to set sail for the islands.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Is Teppei really gonna be okay?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #He has a tendency to dive into action without thinking things through... Paimon can't help but feel a little worried about him. Oh {NICKNAME}, why don't we go wait for him at the <color=#00E1FFFF>training grounds</color>?

choices.text: There was a short test to begin with.

response.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
response.text: Mm, yes. That's standard for the team.

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: #Long time no see, {NICKNAME}!

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: So, how's Swordfish II treating you? Getting along okay with everyone?

response.speaker: Teppei
response.text: Hehe, well you're in luck, because this seasoned veteran's got a few leadership tips for you!

response.speaker: Teppei
response.text: Raising their pay will boost morale, while giving them a few bounties will act as an incentive to go the extra mile. It's also important to maintain strict discipline at all times, and finally... uh, wait, what was it, what was it...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow... Where'd ya learn all that, Teppei?

response.speaker: Teppei
response.text: I read it in a novel from the Yae Publishing House... it was a long time ago. You wouldn't believe how many Dango it took to convince my friend to let me borrow it.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You're seriously gonna use a novel to tell people how to run an army? Pretty sure that's called being an "armchair general"...

response.speaker: Teppei
response.text: Haw-haw, that's where you underestimate me! That's right, I'm learning military management on the job now, just like you.

response.speaker: Teppei
response.text: You'd better believe it! Thanks to my outstanding achievements in the recent naval battle, I've officially been made the captain of my very own special operations unit!

response.speaker: Teppei
response.text: It's a brand new unit: Herring I! What do you think? Pretty awesome, right?

response.speaker: Teppei
response.text: I spoke to Her Excellency and she says our uniforms are in production.

response.speaker: Teppei
response.text: Let's go collect them together once they're ready. I can't wait to put them on! We're really gonna look the part.

response.speaker: Teppei
response.text: Ah, everything's going great. Our mystery sponsor's supplies have really helped turn things around...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Will Paimon get a uniform, too?

response.speaker: Teppei
response.text: Of course! You're a recognized member of the Watatsumi Island resistance.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yippy!

response.speaker: Herring Section 1 Squad Member
response.text: Captain, a new assignment has come in...

response.speaker: Teppei
response.text: #Thank you soldier, I'll be there on the double. Alright, I'd better go. {NICKNAME}, see you again soon.

response.speaker: Teppei
response.text: You'd better watch out, partner — at the rate I'm going, I'll overtake you if you're not careful!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hah, in your dreams, mister!

response.speaker: Teppei
response.text: *clears throat*... I wouldn't be so confident if I were you. I'm at the top of my game right now. This is my time to shine!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon is so surprised that Teppei's been made a platoon captain... He must have been working super hard.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Let's take a break then go check out these <color=#00E1FFFF>Archon War ruins</color>!

choices.text: Eh, they can be a pain in the butt...

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: From now on, let's fight together.

dialogues.speaker: Teppei
dialogues.text: I'll admit, being promoted directly to captain is pretty amazing. But I'm not about to get left behind! I'll see you at the top some day soon.

dialogues.speaker: Swordfish II Provisional Squad Leader
dialogues.text: Show me that you are worthy to lead us.

dialogues.speaker: Swordfish II Veteran
dialogues.text: We make no apologies for holding our leader to the highest standard. Because at the end of the day, your competence decides whether we live or die.
